checks.description: Web beta/prod catch-up path rejects proxy-remuxed/remux-hls gateway playback responses.
checks.notes: Current web resolver tests pass and prove proxy-remuxed/remux-hls responses are not used by the web beta path.

checks.description: Proxy gateway and remux controller runtime do not offer proxy-remuxed playback or direct remux-hls handling, even when env/debug inputs try to allow remux.
checks.notes: Static release validator proves the hard-disable guard and CI/package coverage are still present. Tests prove gateway resolve stays proxy-normalized, debug remux override does not bootstrap a session, direct remux-hls proxy requests are rejected before upstream fetch, __remux__ asset endpoints return remux_disabled, and direct remux controller calls fail before binary checks or process spawn.

checks.description: Committed env/example surfaces do not enable LUMEN_PROXY_REMUX_ENABLED=1 for beta/prod.
checks.notes: No tracked env/example surface enables the proxy remux feature flag.

checks.description: Local/runtime validation observes no ffmpeg or ffprobe process during provider browser QA.
checks.notes: No active ffmpeg or ffprobe process was observed after validation.

checks.description: Captured HAR/JSON/log evidence is scanned with the release no-media evidence scanner for remux, transcode, ffmpeg, ffprobe, generated HLS, and XUI-side media-processing indicators.
checks.notes: Scanner returned OK for the manual network audit report and would fail on __remux__, remux, remux-hls, proxy-remuxed, ffmpeg, ffprobe, transcode, generated HLS, server-side remux, or XUI-side media processing/transcode/remux evidence.

checks.description: Provider/XUI owner confirms catch-up failures will not be solved with XUI-side transcode/remux for beta.
checks.notes: Filip owner signoff confirms no XUI-side transcode/remux/generated-HLS workaround for beta without explicit owner decision.

signoff.notes: Runtime no-media policy, local/proxy safeguards, no-media evidence scan, and provider/XUI no-transcode/no-remux owner confirmation are recorded.
